Summary of websites posted to 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com: Discusses the latest job report showing unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com: Describes Zurich Restaurant, a cozy alpine-inspired eatery in the city center renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Features warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Both sites were shared by employees in the general channel.
